historical_targets: D4 I1 V16, HTTPS V17, bridge V17->V18; checkpoint V21 plus V18->V21 upgrade. D3 original V12/V13/V14/V15 templates and core; D2 V11. Historical groups were not run on V21.
limitations: One checkpoint, exactly two ordered synthetic steps and one binding physical account per operation. General multiple accounts/checkpoints/channels and real usage calibration are not implemented.
Only live RUNNING checkpoint COMMIT is enabled. RECONCILING continuation and conclusive UNKNOWN/contradiction resolution remain excluded.
The fixture reaches its finite prefix checkpoint before the request; preempting a long running process as it reaches a cursor remains outside this campaign.
The verifier is a separately credentialed trusted authority. SQL verifies its bound factual proof and atomic guards; it does not implement Ed25519 verification inside PostgreSQL.
Complete seal lost-reply/restart/successor stability is a component test. Compose tests preserved-volume restart, old callback/grant fencing and end-to-end prefix/suffix settlement.
SQL lease-before-COMMIT rollback test forces an expired lease; S03/S04 separately wait real PostgreSQL leases without advancing clocks.
The D4 planning adapter reuses the inner D3 model/algorithm under qualified captured checkpoint admission. Legacy observation/adapter/publication/dispatch keep their conservative semantics.
Continuation uses an explicit laboratory tick. Outbox facts are stored; no D6 daemon/consumer automatically authorizes or resumes work.
Broad negative matrix is partly covered in SQL/components, not all repeated in Compose. Trusted fixtures only; no hostile-code sandbox, real provider, Git verifier, rollout or D4 closure.
Verifier response failures may require manual review. No unbounded auto-recovery or silent release on uncertainty. Images remain local; only project containers/networks/volumes are removed.
